title: Solids retention time at different temperatures (high rate digestion)

cell_spans.description: 'Operating Temperature, °C' is one tall cell spanning the two printed header rows.
Upper-tier header 'Solids Retention Time, days' spans the SRTc, Suggested for Design (SRTd) and Ratio columns; the lower tier prints those three sub-headings.

notes: Two-tier header: 'Solids Retention Time, days' covers the SRTc, Suggested for Design (SRTd) and Ratio columns; the first column 'Operating Temperature, °C' spans both header rows.

Ratio column is printed as a worked division, e.g. '28/11 = 2.54'; the expressions are transcribed verbatim and not recomputed. 28/11 is 2.5454... and 14/6 is 2.3333..., so the printed results are truncated rather than rounded; printed values retained.
Lower-case 'c' and 'd' in 'SRTc' and 'SRTd' kept as printed.

The Figure 6.7 caption printed immediately above this table describes a 'laboratory scale completely mixed aerobic digester' although this table and its column heads are for high rate (anaerobic) digestion; both are printed as shown and neither was changed.

transcription.method: Direct visual reading of full 144 dpi annotation-cleaned page PNGs plus 288-450 dpi detail crops of each item, rotated where the printed table is set sideways; no OCR, no paid service, no delegation
transcription.observations: First reading only. Every printed value, coefficient, power, sign, bracket, spelling and unit retained as printed; source oddities kept and flagged rather than corrected. No distinct second visual pass performed and no verification seal.
